# capture_known_color_probes_off.txt - QA-SCREEN-CAPTURE P3 (D-W8-20, D-W8-33): the pixels
# tests/container/capture_known_color_smoke.cpp must leave in the relay's CAPTURE of its frame, for the
# context option srgb_framebuffer=off. Format: tests/tools/image_probe.py ("<x> <y> <RRGGBBAA> [<tol>]",
# origin top-left, alpha included). Fixed BEFORE the data existed (GODS_LAWS.md L-43); the scene is
# described in the fixture's own header comment.
#
# wl_shm ARGB8888 is PREMULTIPLIED and the reader does not un-premultiply: a half-transparent piece reads
# as its color times 0.5 in the color channels, alpha 0.5 = 127 or 128 (the rasterizer's rounding, so
# tolerance 2, the one draw2d_parity_test already declares in tests/measured_exceptions.txt). srgb_framebuffer
# off: the color channel of the half-transparent pieces is 80 (0x80 = 128 = encode-first-then-premultiply
# when off; 0xBC = 188 = the hardware encodes the premultiplied value when on).
#
# opaque red square
50 50 FF0000FF 0
# half-transparent white square, over the transparent clear
150 50 80808080 2
# half-transparent red square: green and blue stay at zero (no dark fringe)
50 180 80000080 2
# opaque blue square, the opposite corner from the red one
270 190 0000FFFF 0
# outside every piece: the clear is transparent black, so the destination alpha is real
160 200 00000000 0
